entities.summary: Admiral Frederick Beauchamp Paget Seymour, 1st Baron Alcester, was a Royal Navy officer. He was commander of the Channel Squadron between 1874 and 1877 and Commander-in-Chief of the Mediterranean Fleet between 1880 and 1883.
